desc: Cascadian Farm Organic Dark Chocolate Chip Chewy Granola Bars are packed with organic chocolate paired with wholesome rolled oats for sweet chewy goodness in every bite. With no artificial flavors or preservatives, these chocolate chip granola bars make an organic snack the whole family will enjoy. Take them on your next adventure — whether you need a convenient breakfast bar, hiking fuel or a picnic treat. Cascadian Farm loves wholesome, organic ingredients perfected by Mother Nature, and every Cascadian Farm granola bar supports farmers who use sustainable practices to regenerate the land and their communities.
features:
CHOCOLATE CHIP GRANOLA BAR: Made with organic chocolate paired with wholesome rolled oats for a tasty snack any time of day

NON GMO: Certified organic granola bars made without GMOS or synthetic pesticides

ORGANIC SNACK: Contains no hydrogenated oils; no artificial flavors or preservatives

WHOLESOME INGREDIENTS: Made with 12 grams of whole grain per serving (At least 48 grams recommended daily)

BOX CONTAINS: 1 box, 6 bars
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats*, Tapioca Syrup*, Whole Grain Oat Flour*, Cane Sugar*, Brown Rice Flour*, Water, Dark Chocolate Chips* (cane sugar*, unsweetened chocolate*, cocoa butter*, vanilla powder*), Sunflower Oil*, Brown Rice Syrup*, Grape Juice Concentrate*, Agar, Sea Salt. *Organic
